statement: ∀ p N : ℕ, p.Prime → Odd p → 0 < N → multiplicity p (16*(p^N)^2*(p^N+1)^2) = 2*N

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 同一包络与局部 Szpiro · JA-0053 · 在固定奇素数计算 pᴺ,1,pᴺ+1 的判别式阶
plain_statement.en: New route · Common hull and local Szpiro · JA-0053 · Compute the discriminant order at the fixed odd prime of the Frey family

brief.zh: p 不整除 pᴺ+1，亦不整除 16；该式只计 p。
brief.en: The prime divides neither pᴺ+1 nor 16. Compute only its contribution.
